fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes the trowel at a target up to 6 tiles away, which deals 30 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. It is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Cold Mortar Slap
fusions.desc: Slaps cold mortar round you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 20% chance to leave each one [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Wall
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds, and you have 10% frost resistance.

fusions.name: Warm Stone Sitter
fusions.desc: During the day, your damage rises by 12%.
